lines.zh: 两条长腿一前一后地迈。
lines.en: These two long legs swing one after the other.
My feet fall lightly.

lines.zh: 我踩着前一只的脚印走。
lines.en: I step in the prints of the one ahead.

lines.zh: 每走一步，我的头点一下。
lines.en: Every step, my head bobs once.
I slip through the brush.
My steps come fast.
My tail sways behind.
The whole flock moves together.
The flock moves off toward open ground.
A few steps, then I stop.
I go around the tall grass.
My head stays low, watching the ground.
I stand at the edge of the grass.
My neck stretches up.
I'm listening for something.
The wind lifts my feathers.

lines.zh: 我单脚站着，把另一只收起来。
lines.en: I balance on one leg and tuck the other up.

lines.zh: 同伴在远处短叫，我回了声。
lines.en: A flockmate calls; I answer it.
I tilt my head at the ground.
I've gone motionless.

lines.zh: 我把脖子上的羽毛抖开。
lines.en: I ruffle the feathers on my neck.
The grass keeps swaying.
This spot is open.
I fold my long legs and settle.
I tuck my feet under me.
I wait for a good moment.

lines.zh: 阳光暖着我背上的灰羽。
lines.en: Sun warms the grey feathers on my back.
The flock is nearby.
You're taller than me.
You walk too loudly.
These legs are strong.
What's that in your hand?
The flock won't go far.
Stand back; my legs reach far.
One kick from me goes a long way.
Is there a second one behind you?
Our leader is over there.
See these wings?
I look like a crane. I'm not.

lines.zh: 你不迈步，我就这么看着。
lines.en: You don't step, and I just watch.

lines.zh: 我一蹬地，往后闪出半步。
lines.en: One push and I'm half a step back.
A tuft of grey feathers comes off my wing.
There's a wound on my leg.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，同伴看过来。
lines.en: I called and the flock looked.
I retreated, but stayed.
The leg isn't broken; I can still run.

lines.zh: 身子一歪，我用一条腿撑住。
lines.en: I tip sideways and catch myself on one leg.
You hit bone.
Two hops and I steadied.
There's blood on me.
Do you have food?
I can get this meat down.
Lower your hand and I'll dare come near.
Don't reach; one fright and I'm gone.
The flock all needs feeding.
I snatch it and run, the flock behind me.
This isn't meat, is it?
Throw it. I can catch it.
There are several more beaks behind me.
Keep your hand steady.
You came close; I hopped back.
I'm very light.
Your knee hit my chest.
We both stepped back.
I stepped over your foot.
Feathers brushed your hand.

lines.zh: 被挤到这种地步，我抬脚了。
lines.en: Crowd me this far and my foot comes up.
The others called from nearby.
I turned aside to let you pass.
One block back is enough.
This happens at the clearing's edge.
We both stretch our necks.
The flock watches around us.
It's a bit stronger than me.
We lean together by the grass a long while.
We flattened the grass.
Afterwards we rejoin the flock.
The leader paid us no mind.
It isn't a pretty sight.
Neither of us made a sound.
I dip my head and grip it in my beak.
This one's fairly heavy.
A bug is crawling in the grass.
I tip my head back and swallow it whole.
I carry it across the grass.
This thing is shiny.
I tossed it to the others.
It won't fit in my beak.

lines.zh: 这东西我不碰，留给同伴。
lines.en: I leave this for the flock; it isn't food.
Something shiny fell from your hand.
You've walked into our range.
I raised my head and saw you.
I'm striding your way.
There's more than one pair of eyes in this grass.
The leader has its eye on you.
Back away and we shift with you.
This kick is fast.

lines.zh: 血腥味从你身上飘过来。
lines.en: The smell of blood comes off you.
The grass won't hide you.
This area is ours.

lines.zh: 我朝同伴发了一声短叫。
lines.en: I send a short call to the flock.
The flock turned as one.
Where you stand, there's no room to run.
I move feet first, not beak.
This open ground gives my legs room.

lines.zh: 听见草丛里几声短叫吗。
lines.en: Hear those short cries in the grass?

lines.zh: 我把头压到草丛的高度。
lines.en: I drop my head to the height of the grass.
I've judged the distance.

lines.zh: 我这两条腿一直跟着你转。
lines.en: These long legs keep turning after you.

lines.zh: 你看见我踢的那只小东西吗？
lines.en: See the little thing I kicked?
We're closing in from both sides.
You're at the stones now.

lines.zh: 我一步迈过去，顶你三步。
lines.en: One stride of mine covers three of yours.

lines.zh: 你一转向，整群都跟着转。
lines.en: You turn, and the whole flock turns with you.
The grass keeps rustling.
I hear iron on you.
Our leader is out front.

lines.zh: 我留着余力，一直缀着你。
lines.en: I keep a reserve and stay on your heels.

lines.zh: 你脚下影子长，我踩着它。
lines.en: Your shadow is long; I walk in it.
Nightfall favors us.
You're on open ground.

lines.zh: 我一个同伴绕到后面了。
lines.en: One of us has gone behind you.
There's a gully ahead.

lines.zh: 你的步子已经开始打滑。
lines.en: Your steps are starting to slip.
I'm lifting a leg to kick.
Right at the edge of the grass.

lines.zh: 我身后的草丛里还有同伴。
lines.en: There are flockmates in the grass behind me.
This is the last circle.
I kick out with one leg.
That kick is heavier than you think.
The kick knocked you backwards.
I swept at your legs.
A claw caught you.
I leap and kick.

lines.zh: 这一脚把你踹得连退两步。
lines.en: The kick sends you back two steps.

lines.zh: 这一脚从我腰一直甩到爪。
lines.en: This kick swings from my hip clear to the claw.
The flock came with it.
My feet won't stop.

lines.zh: 这一脚踢在你的铁甲上。
lines.en: The kick lands on your iron plate.
Dirt flew up from the kick.
You're down. More come.

lines.zh: 我一脚踩在你的手背上。
lines.en: My foot comes down on the back of your hand.
I came from the laboratory benches.
I was among the first to open my eyes.
The soil under me is fresh.
The whole flock is here.
I shook my head and neck.
The grass reaches my chest; this will do.
Neck out, I watch for a long while.
The leader stood first.
We called a few times.
I take two steps to test these long legs.
The laboratory door is open.
The light outside falls on the grass.
I smell something alive.
We slowly spread out.
I lifted a leg for the first time.
There's nobody here.
Something stirs; I turn my head toward it.
Our prints are on the ground.
We moved toward that area.
I gave my first call.

lines.zh: 火一烧，我的羽毛全卷了。
lines.en: Fire curled all my feathers.

lines.zh: 落地那一下，我的长腿一软。
lines.en: On landing my long leg gives way.
Water got in; I can't thrash free.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀出去，翻了两圈。
lines.en: The blast throws me clear and I tumble twice.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎穿了我翅膀的羽毛。
lines.en: An arrow punches through the feathers of my wing.
That light held me fast.
No food, no running.
Lightning struck and I jumped.

lines.zh: 脚下空着，我蹬不到任何东西。
lines.en: Empty space; my feet find nothing to kick against.
